name: Unnerving Silence
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
A moment, if you will adventurer. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able go, seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.
narrative.objectives: Find and speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?<Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.>So the message did not get through. We are in dire straights indeed then.It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
